name: Dynamic Image Generator
description: Generates dynamic images from HTML/CSS templates using third-party APIs or a built-in engine, with token replacement and media integration.

suggests.token: Adds a token-tree browser to the Image Template form (drupal/token).

project_description: Dynamic Image Generator creates a custom content entity (`poster_entity`, labelled "Image Template") whose HTML and CSS fields are turned into a rendered image. Templates combine Drupal tokens (e.g. [node:title], [node:field_image]), uploaded template-image tokens ([image_1], [image_2], ...), site-defined custom tokens, and Twig syntax. At generation time the module substitutes those tokens, renders the result, and produces an image either via the external HTML/CSS-to-Image API (htmlcsstoimage.com / hcti.io) or, when the bundled image_creating_engine submodule is enabled, via a local wkhtmltoimage binary. Generated images are stored as a Drupal media entity (media type `dynamic_image`) and can be written back automatically to an image or media-reference field on a node when an editor ticks an "Auto-generate Image" checkbox on the node form. A Views-based gallery of generated images and an admin settings form (API provider, credentials, custom-token definitions, debug mode) round out the module.
